notes.text: Bri helped at the community serve day with a group from her dorm. She worked the whole shift sorting school supplies and asked good questions about what the church does the rest of the year.

notes.author: alisha
notes.text: Bri asked online to join Pastor Pete's group. Let her know it meets in the Fosters' home in the evening. {@pete} will reach out before her first visit.

replies.author: pete
